<h2 id="开心一刻">开心一刻</h2>
<p>我爸去诊所后，回来跟我说了医生的诊断，但我很质疑，我去诊所找医生问清楚</p>
<p>我：医生你好，刚我爸在你诊断完之后，到家不太高兴，说是短裤传太高了</p>
<p>医生：我说的是胆固醇太高了！</p>
<h2 id="前情回顾">前情回顾</h2>
<p><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/youzhibing/p/18561377" target="_blank">不依赖 Spring，你会如何自实现 RabbitMQ 消息的消费（一）</a>中，我们做到了基本的消息消费，实现了以下几点</p>
<ol>
<li>不依赖 Spring</li>
<li>单队列的消息消费</li>
<li>多消费者以及负载均衡</li>
</ol>
<p>但局限性非常大，以下两点都不支持</p>
<blockquote>
<ol>
<li>支持多队列</li>
<li>消费逻辑动态化</li>
</ol>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="支持多队列">支持多队列</h2>
<p>最简单的改动就是将单个队列改成队列集合，类似如下</p>
<div align="center"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/747662/202611/747662-20261127131413319-373374020.png" alt="多队列最简单改动"></div>
<p>启动成功，会有如下类似信息</p>
<pre><code class="language-html">队列：qsl.queue，消费者：amq.ctag-aq6HG7LFqJfVvQALfW5-vw 已经就绪
队列：qsl.queue，消费者：amq.ctag-2CNycn6flZUDCo-j9B1bcw 已经就绪
队列：qsl.queue，消费者：amq.ctag-ac03HDuSg2fErnEAkLJlng 已经就绪
队列：qsl.order，消费者：amq.ctag-uuiGZokUtlcp8as7lWKV9Q 已经就绪
队列：qsl.order，消费者：amq.ctag-PUubKnLhXpwbLTvWEggapw 已经就绪
队列：qsl.order，消费者：amq.ctag--FdiOYkRQoBtaEMvpLir0Q 已经就绪
队列：qsl.payment，消费者：amq.ctag-pwa6eHPePJLu-tZAvE7dxQ 已经就绪
队列：qsl.payment，消费者：amq.ctag-CzskUDiQJKfJS3E0wssLMw 已经就绪
队列：qsl.payment，消费者：amq.ctag-EznYeLUJVypgJ4CoBqYWyA 已经就绪
</code></pre>
<p>我们往队列里面发布消息，会看到如下类似信息</p>
<pre><code class="language-html">amq.ctag-pwa6eHPePJLu-tZAvE7dxQ 收到消息：1
amq.ctag-CzskUDiQJKfJS3E0wssLMw 收到消息：2
amq.ctag-EznYeLUJVypgJ4CoBqYWyA 收到消息：3
amq.ctag-aq6HG7LFqJfVvQALfW5-vw 收到消息：a
amq.ctag-2CNycn6flZUDCo-j9B1bcw 收到消息：b
amq.ctag-ac03HDuSg2fErnEAkLJlng 收到消息：c
</code></pre>
<p>消息能正常消费，说明多队列支持改造成功。但消息预取数是通用的，不能针对不同的队列配置不同的预取数，我们改造下 <code>QslConsumer</code>，将预取数作为其构造方法的入参</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">    static class QslConsumer extends DefaultConsumer {

        QslConsumer(Channel channel, int prefetchCount) throws IOException {
            super(channel);
            channel.basicQos(prefetchCount);
        }

        @Override
        public void handleDelivery(String consumerTag, Envelope envelope, AMQP.BasicProperties properties, byte[] body) throws IOException {
            String message = new String(body, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            System.out.println(consumerTag + " 收到消息：" + message);
            this.getChannel().basicAck(envelope.getDeliveryTag(), false);
            try {
                TimeUnit.SECONDS.sleep(1);
            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                throw new RuntimeException(e);
            }
        }
    }
</code></pre>
<p>创建消费者的时候就可以根据其队列的预取数配置来设置消息预取数</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">    private static final List&lt;String&gt; QUEUE_NAMES = Arrays.asList("qsl.queue", "qsl.order", "qsl.payment");
    private static final int concurrency = 3;
    private static final Map&lt;String, Integer&gt; PREFETCH_COUNT_MAP = new HashMap&lt;String, Integer&gt;() {{
        put("qsl.queue", 1);
        put("qsl.order", 1);
        put("qsl.payment", 1);
    }};

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        ConnectionFactory factory = initConnectionFactory();
        Connection connection = factory.newConnection();
        for (String queueName : QUEUE_NAMES) {
            for (int i = 0; i &lt; concurrency; i++) {
                Channel channel = connection.createChannel();
                QslConsumer qslConsumer = new QslConsumer(channel, PREFETCH_COUNT_MAP.get(queueName));
                String consumerTag = channel.basicConsume(queueName, false, qslConsumer);
                System.out.println("队列：" + queueName + "，消费者：" + consumerTag + " 已经就绪");
            }
        }
    }
</code></pre>
<h2 id="消费逻辑动态化">消费逻辑动态化</h2>
<p>虽然多队列是支持了，但消费逻辑却是固定的，实际应用中，不同的队列肯定对应不同的消费逻辑，例如</p>
<blockquote>
<p>qsl.order 表示订单队列，消费逻辑按订单逻辑处理</p>
<p>qsl.payment 表示支付对立，消费逻辑按支付逻辑处理</p>
</blockquote>
<p>所以我们需要将消息处理抽成接口暴露出去，新增 <code>MessageHandler</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">/**
 * @author 青石路
 */
@FunctionalInterface
public interface MessageHandler {

    void handle(String consumerTag, Envelope envelope, AMQP.BasicProperties properties, byte[] body, Channel channel) throws IOException;
}
</code></pre>
<p>将其绑定消费者</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">    /** 消费者：统一处理 QoS，并将消息委派给对应队列的 {@link MessageHandler} */
    static class QslConsumer extends DefaultConsumer {

        private final MessageHandler handler;

        QslConsumer(Channel channel, int prefetchCount, MessageHandler handler) throws IOException {
            super(channel);
            channel.basicQos(prefetchCount);
            this.handler = handler;
        }

        @Override
        public void handleDelivery(String consumerTag, Envelope envelope, AMQP.BasicProperties properties, byte[] body) throws IOException {
            handler.handle(consumerTag, envelope, properties, body, getChannel());
        }
    }
</code></pre>
<p>不同的队列创建不同的消费者</p>
<p>QueueMessageHandler</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">/**
 * qsl.queue 队列消费逻辑
 *
 * @author 青石路
 */
public class QueueMessageHandler implements MessageHandler {

    @Override
    public void handle(String consumerTag, Envelope envelope, AMQP.BasicProperties properties, byte[] body, Channel channel) {
        System.out.println(consumerTag + " [普通队列] 收到消息：" + new String(body, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        System.out.println("进行普通处理...");
        try {
            channel.basicAck(envelope.getDeliveryTag(), false);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            System.err.println(consumerTag + " 处理消息异常：" + e.getMessage());
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p>OrderMessageHandler</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">/**
 * qsl.order 队列消费逻辑
 *
 * @author 青石路
 */
public class OrderMessageHandler implements MessageHandler {

    @Override
    public void handle(String consumerTag, Envelope envelope, AMQP.BasicProperties properties, byte[] body, Channel channel) {
        System.out.println(consumerTag + " [订单队列] 收到消息：" + new String(body, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        System.out.println("进行订单处理...");
        try {
            channel.basicAck(envelope.getDeliveryTag(), false);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            System.err.println(consumerTag + " 处理消息异常：" + e.getMessage());
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p>PaymentMessageHandler</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">/**
 * qsl.payment 队列消费逻辑
 *
 * @author 青石路
 */
public class PaymentMessageHandler implements MessageHandler {

    @Override
    public void handle(String consumerTag, Envelope envelope, AMQP.BasicProperties properties, byte[] body, Channel channel) {
        System.out.println(consumerTag + " [支付队列] 收到消息：" + new String(body, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        System.out.println("进行支付处理...");
        try {
            channel.basicAck(envelope.getDeliveryTag(), false);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            System.err.println(consumerTag + " ACK 失败：" + e.getMessage());
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p>创建消费者的时候绑定对应的 Handler</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">    private static final Map&lt;String, Integer&gt; PREFETCH_COUNT_MAP = new HashMap&lt;&gt;();
    /** 不同队列绑定不同的消费逻辑 */
    private static final Map&lt;String, MessageHandler&gt; HANDLER_MAP = new HashMap&lt;&gt;();

    static {
        PREFETCH_COUNT_MAP.put("qsl.queue", 1);
        PREFETCH_COUNT_MAP.put("qsl.order", 1);
        PREFETCH_COUNT_MAP.put("qsl.payment", 1);

        HANDLER_MAP.put("qsl.queue", new QueueMessageHandler());
        HANDLER_MAP.put("qsl.order", new OrderMessageHandler());
        HANDLER_MAP.put("qsl.payment", new PaymentMessageHandler());
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        ConnectionFactory factory = initConnectionFactory();
        Connection connection = factory.newConnection();
        for (String queueName : QUEUE_NAMES) {
            for (int i = 0; i &lt; concurrency; i++) {
                Channel channel = connection.createChannel();
                QslConsumer qslConsumer = new QslConsumer(channel, PREFETCH_COUNT_MAP.get(queueName), HANDLER_MAP.get(queueName));
                String consumerTag = channel.basicConsume(queueName, false, qslConsumer);
                System.out.println("队列：" + queueName + "，消费者：" + consumerTag + " 已经就绪");
            }
        }
    }
</code></pre>
<p>我们往队列里发送消息，会看到如下类似输出</p>
<pre><code class="language-html">amq.ctag-58AMXQ-8AGTdpfQCUP6lYA [普通队列] 收到消息：1
进行普通处理...
amq.ctag-TnthzoE0mRvhRffVE-aWuw [普通队列] 收到消息：2
进行普通处理...
amq.ctag-QRFD-6HjEYRcJIar1-HGgA [普通队列] 收到消息：3
进行普通处理...
amq.ctag-fgxAbNIBwo8t48UAYxWyxw [订单队列] 收到消息：order1
进行订单处理...
amq.ctag-yoKDKXppmMQIz82hTWMqYA [订单队列] 收到消息：order2
进行订单处理...
amq.ctag-MVj73RMWz9r2aH0IATbv0w [订单队列] 收到消息：order3
进行订单处理...
amq.ctag-FdJg85Ys45SNRt9n8H_y4A [支付队列] 收到消息：payment
进行支付处理...
amq.ctag-DIsk28JeX58UssyMlf_hMQ [支付队列] 收到消息：payment1
进行支付处理...
amq.ctag-vpMJW5PH0shqIrWn_NQWPA [支付队列] 收到消息：payment2
进行支付处理...
</code></pre>
<p>是不是实现了消费逻辑的的动态化？</p>
<h2 id="自动扫描并注册">自动扫描并注册</h2>
<p>现有实现，新增一个队列，改动点还是比较多</p>
<ol>
<li>常量集合（QUEUE_NAMES、PREFETCH_COUNT_MAP、HANDLER_MAP）中添加对应的队列</li>
<li>新增 MessageHandler</li>
</ol>
<p>第 2 点无法避免，但第 1 点是可以固化的，怎么固化呢？比较彻底的做法是：<code>注解</code> + <code>自动扫描</code></p>
<p>我们通过注解将队列绑定到消费逻辑上</p>
<p>自定义一个注解：QslListener</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">/**
 * 队列监听注解：把队列名与消费逻辑绑定在被标注的方法上
 * &lt;p&gt;
 * 新增一个队列 = 新增一个标注本注解的方法即可，无需改动 main 或任何配置表。
 *
 * @author: 青石路
 */
@Documented
@Target(ElementType.METHOD)
@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
public @interface QslListener {

    /** 绑定的队列名，可一个方法监听多个队列 */
    String[] queues();

    /** 每个消费者通道的 QoS（basicQos），属于通道级属性 */
    int prefetch() default 1;
}
</code></pre>
<p>将队列绑定到消费逻辑</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">    @QslListener(queues = "qsl.queue", prefetch = 1)
    public void onQueue(String consumerTag, Envelope envelope, AMQP.BasicProperties properties, byte[] body, Channel channel) {
        System.out.println(consumerTag + " [普通队列] 收到消息：" + new String(body, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        try {
            channel.basicAck(envelope.getDeliveryTag(), false);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            System.err.println(consumerTag + " 处理异常：" + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    @QslListener(queues = "qsl.order", prefetch = 1)
    public void onOrder(String consumerTag, Envelope envelope, AMQP.BasicProperties properties, byte[] body, Channel channel) {
        System.out.println(consumerTag + " [订单队列] 收到消息：" + new String(body, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        try {
            channel.basicAck(envelope.getDeliveryTag(), false);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            System.err.println(consumerTag + " 处理异常：" + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    @QslListener(queues = "qsl.payment", prefetch = 1)
    public void onPayment(String consumerTag, Envelope envelope, AMQP.BasicProperties properties, byte[] body, Channel channel) {
        System.out.println(consumerTag + " [支付队列] 收到消息：" + new String(body, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        try {
            channel.basicAck(envelope.getDeliveryTag(), false);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            System.err.println(consumerTag + " ACK 异常：" + e.getMessage());
        }
    }
</code></pre>
<p>队列绑定到消费逻辑上了之后就结束了吗，并没有，我们还需要将消费逻辑绑定到消费者</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">    // ==================== 消费者：把回调委派给被注解的方法 ====================

    static class QslConsumer extends DefaultConsumer {

        private final Object bean;
        private final Method method;

        QslConsumer(Channel channel, Object bean, Method method) {
            super(channel);
            this.bean = bean;
            this.method = method;
        }

        @Override
        public void handleDelivery(String consumerTag, Envelope envelope, AMQP.BasicProperties properties, byte[] body) throws IOException {
            try {
                method.invoke(bean, consumerTag, envelope, properties, body, getChannel());
            } catch (InvocationTargetException e) {
                System.err.println("监听方法执行业务异常：" + e.getTargetException());
            } catch (Exception e) {
                System.err.println("反射调用监听方法失败：" + e.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }
</code></pre>
<p>其中的 <code>bean</code> 和 <code>method</code> 都表示什么，你们能看出来吗？</p>
<blockquote>
<p>method 很明显就是消费逻辑对应的方法，例如 <code>onQueue</code>、<code>onOrder</code>、<code>onPayment</code></p>
<p>bean 则是消费逻辑对应方法的类实例</p>
</blockquote>
<p>绑定好之后就完事了吗，并没有，还未创建消费者实例，无法正常工作。我们采用自动扫描的方式，先扫描全部 <code>Class</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">    /** 扫描包路径下的全部类（同时支持 file 目录与 jar 包两种形式） */
    private static List&lt;Class&lt;?&gt;&gt; scan(String basePackage) throws Exception {
        List&lt;Class&lt;?&gt;&gt; classes = new ArrayList&lt;&gt;();
        String path = basePackage.replace('.', '/');
        ClassLoader cl = Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader();
        Enumeration&lt;URL&gt; urls = cl.getResources(path);
        while (urls.hasMoreElements()) {
            URL url = urls.nextElement();
            String protocol = url.getProtocol();
            if ("file".equals(protocol)) {
                // 目录形式（如 target/classes）
                collect(new File(url.toURI()), basePackage, classes);
            } else if ("jar".equals(protocol)) {
                // jar 形式（打成 jar 运行时）
                scanJar(url, path, cl, classes);
            } else {
                System.err.println("暂不支持的资源协议，已忽略：" + url);
            }
        }
        return classes;
    }

    /** 扫描 jar 包内 basePackage（含子包）下的全部类 */
    private static void scanJar(URL url, String packagePath, ClassLoader cl, List&lt;Class&lt;?&gt;&gt; out) throws Exception {
        // url 形如 jar:file:/xxx/yyy.jar!/com/qsl/multi/queueconfig
        JarURLConnection conn = (JarURLConnection) url.openConnection();
        conn.setUseCaches(false);
        JarFile jarFile = conn.getJarFile();
        Enumeration&lt;JarEntry&gt; entries = jarFile.entries();
        while (entries.hasMoreElements()) {
            JarEntry entry = entries.nextElement();
            String name = entry.getName();
            if (name.startsWith(packagePath) &amp;&amp; name.endsWith(".class")) {
                String className = name.substring(0, name.length() - ".class".length()).replace('/', '.');
                out.add(Class.forName(className, false, cl));
            }
        }
    }

    private static void collect(File dir, String pkg, List&lt;Class&lt;?&gt;&gt; out) throws ClassNotFoundException {
        File[] files = dir.listFiles();
        if (files == null) {
            return;
        }
        for (File file : files) {
            if (file.isDirectory()) {
                collect(file, pkg + "." + file.getName(), out);
            } else if (file.getName().endsWith(".class")) {
                String simpleName = file.getName().substring(0, file.getName().length() - ".class".length());
                out.add(Class.forName(pkg + "." + simpleName));
            }
        }
    }
</code></pre>
<p>然后获取 Class 中的 <code>QslListener</code> 注解，以及被 QslListener  修饰的 <code>Method</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">    private static List&lt;Method&gt; findListenerMethods(Class&lt;?&gt; clazz) {
        List&lt;Method&gt; methods = new ArrayList&lt;&gt;();
        for (Method method : clazz.getDeclaredMethods()) {
            if (method.isAnnotationPresent(QslListener.class)) {
                methods.add(method);
            }
        }
        return methods;
    }

    private static void validateSignature(Method method) {
        Class&lt;?&gt;[] p = method.getParameterTypes();
        boolean ok = p.length == 5
                &amp;&amp; p[0] == String.class
                &amp;&amp; p[1] == Envelope.class
                &amp;&amp; p[2] == AMQP.BasicProperties.class
                &amp;&amp; p[3] == byte[].class
                &amp;&amp; p[4] == Channel.class;
        if (!ok) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("@QslListener 方法签名必须为 "
                    + "(String, Envelope, AMQP.BasicProperties, byte[], Channel)：" + method);
        }
    }
</code></pre>
<p>最后通过反射创建含有 QslListener 注解的类的实例，并将该实例以及被 QslListener  修饰的 Method 作为 QslConsumer 的构造参数来创建消费者实例</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        ConnectionFactory factory = initConnectionFactory();
        Connection connection = factory.newConnection();

        // 通过当前调用栈获取 main 方法所在类的包名作为扫描基包（不写死类名/包名，也不产生额外内部类）
        String className = Thread.currentThread().getStackTrace()[1].getClassName();
        String basePackage = className.substring(0, className.lastIndexOf('.'));
        List&lt;Class&lt;?&gt;&gt; classes = scan(basePackage);
        int consumerCount = 0;
        for (Class&lt;?&gt; clazz : classes) {
            List&lt;Method&gt; methods = findListenerMethods(clazz);
            if (methods.isEmpty()) {
                continue;
            }
            // 仅对有监听方法的类实例化（需无参构造）
            Object bean = clazz.getDeclaredConstructor().newInstance();
            for (Method method : methods) {
                QslListener anno = method.getAnnotation(QslListener.class);
                validateSignature(method);
                method.setAccessible(true);
                for (String queue : anno.queues()) {
                    for (int i = 0; i &lt; concurrency; i++) {
                        Channel channel = connection.createChannel();
                        channel.basicQos(anno.prefetch());
                        String consumerTag = channel.basicConsume(queue, false, new QslConsumer(channel, bean, method));
                        consumerCount++;
                        System.out.println("注册监听：队列=" + queue + "，方法="
                                + clazz.getSimpleName() + "#" + method.getName() + "，消费者=" + consumerTag);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println("扫描完成：共扫描 " + classes.size() + " 个类，注册 " + consumerCount + " 个消费者");
    }
</code></pre>
<p>至此，整个流程才算完成，启动后会有如下类似输出</p>
<pre><code class="language-html">注册监听：队列=qsl.payment，方法=QueueListeners#onPayment，消费者=amq.ctag-zJBSYex7Chcg0cGVFA9bmw
注册监听：队列=qsl.payment，方法=QueueListeners#onPayment，消费者=amq.ctag-8Uy4kXyrQSGVHYrYmig_ZA
注册监听：队列=qsl.payment，方法=QueueListeners#onPayment，消费者=amq.ctag-FfeSYekWKLF9RTl-DcX5sA
注册监听：队列=qsl.order，方法=QueueListeners#onOrder，消费者=amq.ctag-youIcLyyexXhT5YSzU1JXw
注册监听：队列=qsl.order，方法=QueueListeners#onOrder，消费者=amq.ctag-DVH9tpaL5oHw3yI29J-NHA
注册监听：队列=qsl.order，方法=QueueListeners#onOrder，消费者=amq.ctag-BzczdX8oQwdmz8gMw14wFQ
注册监听：队列=qsl.queue，方法=QueueListeners#onQueue，消费者=amq.ctag-pwg4TYbWj5fR2jAIPlfybQ
注册监听：队列=qsl.queue，方法=QueueListeners#onQueue，消费者=amq.ctag-XGevdLvmzHXguJKXUwIEeg
注册监听：队列=qsl.queue，方法=QueueListeners#onQueue，消费者=amq.ctag-N7DvqX9_i6RsVRURbKeTPA
扫描完成：共扫描 4 个类，注册 9 个消费者
</code></pre>
<p>细心的小伙伴可能会有疑问，明明是 3 个类，为什么扫描到 4 个类</p>
<div align="center"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/747662/202611/747662-20261127131641636-363013587.png" alt="三个类"></div>
<p>因为有个内部类 <code>QslConsumer</code></p>
<p>我们往队列里面发送消息，会看到如下类似输出</p>
<pre><code class="language-html">amq.ctag-pwg4TYbWj5fR2jAIPlfybQ [普通队列] 收到消息：queue1
amq.ctag-XGevdLvmzHXguJKXUwIEeg [普通队列] 收到消息：queue2
amq.ctag-N7DvqX9_i6RsVRURbKeTPA [普通队列] 收到消息：queue3
amq.ctag-youIcLyyexXhT5YSzU1JXw [订单队列] 收到消息：order1
amq.ctag-DVH9tpaL5oHw3yI29J-NHA [订单队列] 收到消息：order2
amq.ctag-BzczdX8oQwdmz8gMw14wFQ [订单队列] 收到消息：order3
amq.ctag-zJBSYex7Chcg0cGVFA9bmw [支付队列] 收到消息：playment1
amq.ctag-8Uy4kXyrQSGVHYrYmig_ZA [支付队列] 收到消息：playment2
amq.ctag-FfeSYekWKLF9RTl-DcX5sA [支付队列] 收到消息：playment3
</code></pre>
<p>后续再添加新的队列，改动就非常简单了，比如我们新增队列：<code>qsl.email</code></p>
<p>直接在 QueueListeners.java 中添加</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">    @QslListener(queues = "qsl.email", prefetch = 1)
    public void onEmail(String consumerTag, Envelope envelope, AMQP.BasicProperties properties, byte[] body, Channel channel) {
        System.out.println(consumerTag + " [邮件队列] 收到消息：" + new String(body, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        try {
            channel.basicAck(envelope.getDeliveryTag(), false);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            System.err.println(consumerTag + " ACK 异常：" + e.getMessage());
        }
    }
</code></pre>
<p>即可，也可以在 basePackage 下创建新的类，然后在新类中添加如上内容，然后重新启动，会看到有邮件队列的信息了</p>
<pre><code class="language-html">注册监听：队列=qsl.email，方法=QueueListeners#onEmail，消费者=amq.ctag-Q2SsAvYVQIsZUTJTL4pjIQ
注册监听：队列=qsl.email，方法=QueueListeners#onEmail，消费者=amq.ctag-yXT5aUy5qaOCHAsNBAssFw
注册监听：队列=qsl.email，方法=QueueListeners#onEmail，消费者=amq.ctag-iGFsoPZKrXHlTgcl_ypjsg
注册监听：队列=qsl.queue，方法=QueueListeners#onQueue，消费者=amq.ctag-L1rr2kfmBtjC8oKpp8KbXg
注册监听：队列=qsl.queue，方法=QueueListeners#onQueue，消费者=amq.ctag-fBjn_6yyoHPhRM8aED7-XA
注册监听：队列=qsl.queue，方法=QueueListeners#onQueue，消费者=amq.ctag-bRuJMC3cxOHAuK2ZfNYmfw
注册监听：队列=qsl.order，方法=QueueListeners#onOrder，消费者=amq.ctag-0q0NpSf6xe6YzJqG-IpGKA
注册监听：队列=qsl.order，方法=QueueListeners#onOrder，消费者=amq.ctag-I2YH8NwPgJawvYeib3Aiqg
注册监听：队列=qsl.order，方法=QueueListeners#onOrder，消费者=amq.ctag-xfksu9YWAqvBKNo6uosTIA
注册监听：队列=qsl.payment，方法=QueueListeners#onPayment，消费者=amq.ctag-ZJOF5Sga6w0smwgihkqsPw
注册监听：队列=qsl.payment，方法=QueueListeners#onPayment，消费者=amq.ctag-K3x0uXOP6XXsihdVonhSTg
注册监听：队列=qsl.payment，方法=QueueListeners#onPayment，消费者=amq.ctag-ZBOvwg0kHtqMY5HZAvxP6g
扫描完成：共扫描 4 个类，注册 12 个消费者
</code></pre>
<p>往 qsl.email 中发送消息，会看到如下类似输出</p>
<pre><code class="language-html">amq.ctag-Q2SsAvYVQIsZUTJTL4pjIQ [邮件队列] 收到消息：email1
amq.ctag-yXT5aUy5qaOCHAsNBAssFw [邮件队列] 收到消息：email2
amq.ctag-iGFsoPZKrXHlTgcl_ypjsg [邮件队列] 收到消息：email3
</code></pre>
<p>添加新的队列就非常简单了</p>
<h2 id="总结">总结</h2>
<ol>
<li>将队列与消费逻辑通过注解进行绑定，实现队列与消费逻辑的一一映射</li>
<li>自动扫描并注册消费者，实现消费者的动态创建，拓展性强</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="改进点">改进点</h2>
<ol>
<li>缺少生命周期管理，不够优雅</li>
<li>接收与处理没有解耦，并发度低</li>
</ol>
